body:
CCELL designs CCELL Rizo Battery to work with its own system. If you already use that line, this is a straightforward way to add or replace a part without changing your whole device.

CCELL Rizo Battery is listed at $19.99 in our Vaporizers range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Vaporizers](/shop/vaporizers/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** CCELL
- **Category:** Vaporizers
- **Flavor:** Rizo Battery
- **Price:** $19.99
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Clear product naming:** so you can confirm compatibility before you order.
- **Made for a specific system:** which helps with fit and reduces trial and error.

## Who it suits
This listing is best for adult owners of the matching vaporizer system who are replacing a part or adding an accessory.

## Using and caring for it
Follow the manufacturer's instructions for your device, make sure parts are clean and dry before assembly, and handle glass or small components carefully. Store accessories in a secure, dry place away from children and pets, and use them only for legal products in your state.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
Checkout accepts Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, crypto and gift cards. Choosing crypto or a gift card takes 10% off your total, and orders of $200 or more after that discount ship free. A flat $15 fee applies to smaller orders, and the minimum order is $100.

Your parcel leaves our Phoenix Stock Warehouse within 24 to 72 business hours and ships with a tracking number. Adult signature (21+) is required on delivery, as federal PACT Act rules require for vapor products, so please plan to be available or choose an address where an adult can sign.

## Choosing with confidence
A good habit with any nicotine product is to start with the option that matches your current use rather than jumping to the highest strength or the largest size. If you are switching from another brand, compare the strength and capacity figures on this page with what you used before, and keep the packaging so you can reorder the exact product later. Products are for adult use only.

## Returns and support
If something is wrong with your order, contact us within 30 days and we will help. Unopened items in original packaging can be returned or exchanged, a 15% restocking fee applies to refunds, and refunds go back through the payment method you originally used. Opened or used e-liquid and devices cannot be returned. Our refund policy has the full details. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
